children: shares gained 4% Monday after the chipmaker detailed a set of 2-nanometer optical connectivity demonstrations aimed at AI data centers.

The company plans to present the technology during ECOC 2026, a major European optical communications conference. The demonstrations cover several configurations designed for higher-speed links inside and between data center facilities.

Marvell will show 400G-per-lane optical PAM4 using its 2nm process, along with an 800G ZR/ZR+ pluggable solution that includes MACsec security. PAM4 is an optical signaling method used to transmit more data through each lane.

The portfolio also includes demonstrations of 1.6T ZR and O-band coherent-lite technology. Marvell said the solutions are intended to support the increasing bandwidth requirements of AI infrastructure.

The company's ECOC lineup comes as data center operators seek faster optical connections while managing power consumption and network security. The technologies will be displayed at the event in Malaga, Spain, which runs through Sept. 24. The demonstrations reflect Marvell's focus on optical components as AI workloads place additional demands on data center networking capacity, speed and efficiency.

title: Marvell Shares Rally After Unveiling 1.6T Optical Technology for AI Networks
